event_detail: Drawer: the robot turns and moves around with the empty gripper held up, pointing at the floor and counter edge, without reaching for any drawer handle.
evidence: All drawer fronts under the counter look closed (handles flush) in every frame. The gripper is raised high and holds nothing; the wrist camera mostly sees the tiled floor and the underside/edge of a counter, with the view rotating between frames. The glass cup still stands next to the plant on the counter with no straw. 46-51 s into the episode with the drawer still closed and no reach toward it suggests wandering.
